media.ext_alt_text: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) has suspended its expanded number coding scheme during the Christmas and New Year holidays.

data.text:
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Monday (Dec. 22, 2025) announces an expanded suspension of the number coding scheme for the holiday season.

Aside from the regular and special holidays, the number coding scheme is also suspended on Dec. 29, 2025 (Monday) and Jan. 2, 2026 (Friday), when government work is suspended under Memorandum Circular 111 issued by Malacañang. | MMDA photo

NUMBER CODING, SINUSPENDE SA PASKO AT BAGONG TAON
 
Hindi ipatutupad ang number coding scheme sa mga kalsada sa Metro Manila ngayong Pasko at Bagong Taon, ayon sa MMDA.
 
Suspendido rin ito sa December 30, Rizal Day, pati na sa December 29 at January 2 na idineklarang walang pasok sa mga tanggapan ng gobyerno.
 
(Courtesy: MMDA)
